## About

**Masque: Caith** is an add-on for [World of Warcraft](https://worldofwarcraft.com/ "World of Warcraft") that adds a custom skin for [Masque](https://github.com/SFX-WoW/Masque "Download Masque") .

## Skin

This add-on contains the following skin:

* **Caith** \- A larger version of [Apathy](https://github.com/SFX-WoW/Masque_Apathy "Apathy Skin") inspired by [Caith UI](https://www.wowinterface.com/downloads/info11255 "Caith UI @ WoW Interface") .

## Requirements

This add-on requires [Masque](https://github.com/SFX-WoW/Masque "Download Masque") .

## Installation

Install the package through your preferred add-on manager or extract the archive to your add-ons directory.

## Credits

* [Caith](https://www.wowinterface.com/forums/member.php?userid=133201 "Caith @ WoW Interface") for the [their UI](https://www.wowinterface.
com/downloads/info11255 "Caith UI @ WoW Interface") .
* [Zeal](https://www.curseforge.com/members/zealvurte "Zeal @ CurseForge") for the original **Vol** skin.

## Feedback

For bug reports and suggestions, use the [issue tracker](https://github.com/SFX-WoW/Masque_Caith/issues "Report an Issue") . Direct any questions or comments to [Discord](https://discord.gg/7MTWRgDzz8 "Join the Discord") .

## Localization

To help translate this add-on, use the [localization system](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/masque-caith/localization "Translate on CurseForge") . Alternatively, you can use the [issue tracker](https://github.com/SFX-WoW/Masque_Caith/issues "Report an Issue") .
